# PiTTy 1.0.0

PiTTy 1.0 is a redesign of the main screen. The transcript is quieter, agents live in the sidebar, and every dialog has the same frame. Session files, settings and keys stay compatible. No migration is required.

## A quieter transcript

Each tool call is one row with its status, tool name, main argument and duration. Durations under 100ms are hidden. A timeout or wait limit shows only when it is over 10 seconds. A finished thought collapses to one row. Click it, or press `Ctrl+O`, to show the reasoning.

## Agents in the sidebar

The top bar shows only sessions. Agents are listed in the right sidebar under `◆ Main`. Open one to see its transcript in the main view, with the same layout as the main chat. Steer it from the prompt, or pause, resume and stop it from the header. The sidebar then shows that agent's model and context.

Agent transcripts and restored sessions now show where context was compacted.

## Context and speed

The sidebar shows a context meter with the remaining tokens. It also shows the model's live tokens per second, marked faster, usual or slower than that model's median.

## Consistent dialogs

Settings, model picker, subagent models, MCP servers, themes, sessions, forks and every other dialog share one frame and close label. Dialogs stop above the prompt, so an unsent draft stays visible.

```sh
pitty upgrade
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mistrjirka/PiTTy/compare/v0.8.1...v1.0.0)
